scope: Existing source-backed 27-game pressure signal and earlier-date forecast prior. No new official source data or live forecast admitted.

passes.title: Cross-season and within-game replication
passes.interpretation: Descriptive conditional association only; game-sign p-values would be invalid as independent evidence due shared dates and site/measurement.

passes.title: Leave-one-date-out robustness
passes.interpretation: All four leave-one-calendar-date-out pooled rate gaps remain positive. Only four dates, one in January 2025, so not independent full-season validation.

passes.title: Adversarial boundary-case and source-integrity audit

source_issues: No steal marked is not dead ball
Game-clock 15 seconds can include stopped-clock FT
Event-adjacent opponent score not official points-off-turnovers
Same BRef provider on both cohorts
Scoring outcome after turnover must never be fed into earlier as-of model
No defender identity or five-man lineups

passes.interpretation: Retain losing games and near-zero game rather than silently filter.

passes.title: Forecast-incrementality veto
passes.interpretation: Do not promote pressure features: sample single 2025 training day; no evidence of out-of-sample incremental forecasting skill.

passes.title: Node allocations and next release criteria

result.scout: Source exact event ordering, original bytes and timestamps; add past-only steal-type + prior quick-score features, avoid post-cutoff data
result.filter: Independent box/period/turnover and eventually possession parity; preserve rejects
result.oracle: Train on multiple earlier full dates; future witnessed H1 and Q3 freezes; compare historical prior and latest-rate
result.edge_thief: Guard leakage, noncausal interpretation, false dead-ball and defender claims
result.calibrator: Date-cluster MAE, uncertainty intervals, game-balanced and calibration checks
result.pricing: Only after predictive skill: exact DraftKings available price and de-vig; Human Final Gate required
